parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance to which the transit router belongs.

parameters.name: CenOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the CEN instance belongs.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **VPC**: VPC instance.
- **ExpressConnect**: VBR instance.
- **VPN**: IPsec connection.
- **ECR**: ECR instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query region IDs.
